scope: Revised representative Ready status sample (queue.ready, third generation) under the refreshed contract: owner-required check mark with asymmetrical arms; later consumer destination assets/ready-confirmed.png. Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, check-mark, readability and accent-relationship checks are required at this stage, plus two scoped specialist sample criteria. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused vs Ready), the style-approval decision, placement at assets/ready-confirmed.png and renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus are deferred later-stage obligations recorded with stage and prerequisites in rev3/request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready status image for later delivery to the consumer path assets/ready-confirmed.png. Owner requirements: check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion, transparent background, cool blue accent, no fixed palette (partial alpha permitted). Specialist sample choices, revisable at style review: short left arm with longer right arm, chunky ~2px strokes, sky blue near #70b9ed with one lighter highlight, no backing plate or shadow.

criteria.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
criteria.basis: Owner brief: 16x16 logical status cells, Ready is static, and the current update keeps the 16x16 canvas and static behavior. Consumer: succeeded maps to frames 1 and display.cell is [16,16].

sources.locator: Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels; Ready and Retry are static images
Current update: keep the existing 16x16 canvas, static behavior

criteria.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
criteria.basis: Owner brief requires transparent backgrounds and the current update keeps them; it does not restrict alpha to binary values.

criteria.check: The image visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms: the mark is not mirror-symmetric about its vertex. Asymmetry may come, for example, from clearly unequal arm lengths or from clearly different arm angles/directions; unequal length is one example, not the required condition. The mark conveys successful completion. Either arm may be the longer one, and stroke weight, colour treatment and construction are not restricted by this criterion.
criteria.basis: Owner requirement from the current brief update: Ready must visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion.
